---
title: "The Bond Films!"
---

This page foucses on the box-office revenue for the James Bond Films over time. 

```{python}
#| echo: true
#| label: fig-bond-revenue
#| fig-cap: "James Bond film revenues over time." 

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")

bond = films[films["franchise"] == "James Bond"]
bond = bond.sort_values("year")

plt.plot(bond["year"], bond["revenue_musd"], marker="o")
plt.xlabel("Year")
plt.ylabel("Revenue in MUSD")
plt.show()

```

The first James Bond film in this dataset was released in `{python} int(bond["year"].min())`, and the last was released in `{python} int(bond["year"].max()) # min for the smallest year, max for the biggest year`
